title: Global recruitment-fee detection rules
summary: Deterministic regex rules that match common recruitment-fee request patterns across corridors. Fires before the model speaks.

source.citation: Composite ruleset for the public hub demo. Each production rule is curator-vetted with a citation.

review_notes: Reviewed false-positive rate on a 2400-message sample; observed 1.4 percent.

rules.label: Explicit placement-fee request
rules.rationale: Catches verbatim placement-fee asks. Most actionable when paired with corridor context.

rules.label: Recruitment-fee via informal loan
rules.rationale: Loan-from-agency is a common workaround when explicit fees are illegal.

rules.label: Passport-retention request
rules.rationale: Direct retention requests. Production rule should pair with employer/recruiter context.
